name: zoxilsi studio
summary: WebGL mesh-gradient studio: design gradient backdrops and export them as PNG, video or code.
description: A GPU-accelerated browser studio for mesh gradients, silky waves, geometric patterns and spotlight backdrops: OKLab blending, 100+ presets, live effects and one-click export to PNG, video and code. The page is a JavaScript app, so only its title, meta description and canvas controls (mesh grid rows/columns, topology, canvas size) were readable.
contains: mesh gradients, silky waves, geometric patterns, spotlight backdrops
canvas controls: mesh grid rows/columns, topology, canvas size
one-click export to PNG, video and code
